user.title: Add Surplife controller
user.description: Discovered controllers are listed below. To add one manually, choose "Enter an IP address" and type the address of the controller.

manual.title: Enter an IP address
manual.description: Enter the IP address of the Surplife controller. A DHCP reservation is strongly recommended so the address does not change.

confirm.title: Confirm controller
confirm.description: Found {model} at {host} with firmware {firmware}. Add it?

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the controller at that address.
error.not_supported: That address answered, but it is not a Surplife 0xB6 controller.
error.unknown: Unexpected error talking to the controller.

abort.already_configured: This controller is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No controllers answered the discovery broadcast. Enter an IP address manually.

init.title: Surplife controller options
init.description:
Configure how an effect behaves once, then pick it from the light card and it comes back the way you set it.

{effects_configured} of {effects_total} effects and {looks_configured} of {looks_total} per-LED looks have saved settings.

menu_options.scribble: Paint the strip LED by LED

effect.title: Choose an effect
effect.description: Each effect lists the controls it actually uses. Effects that paint their own colours take none.

effect_settings.title: Configure {effect}

look.title: Choose a per-LED look
look.description: A look paints each of the {count} LEDs individually. The number of colours is what that pattern uses.

look_settings.title: Configure {look}
look_settings.description:
{description}

These colours are used the next time you pick this look from the look selector. Set a white level to light the white LED for that colour instead of simulating white from red, green and blue.

interval.title: Poll interval
interval.description: How often Home Assistant reads the controller's state. This is mostly to notice changes made by the app or by the hardware timers; it does not affect how quickly commands are sent.

recolour.title: Colours for {effect}
recolour.description:
{effect} is running. Pick the colours it should use and they are applied straight away — the effect keeps running.

It takes up to {max} colour(s) and {rows} can be set right now. Turn on "Add another colour" for one more row, or "Remove the last colour" to take one away. Leave a colour empty to skip it; set a white level to light the white LED as well as, or instead of, the colour.

scribble.title: Paint the strip
scribble.description:
Each row is a stretch of the strip, laid end to end. This is the per-LED "doodle" the phone app paints, done with pickers instead of a brush.

The strip has {leds} LEDs. {rows} group(s) cover {covered} of them; {left} are left dark. Set how many LEDs a group covers, pick its colour, then choose whether it lights steadily, blinks, or is left dark.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the controller, so the setting was not applied.
error.no_leds: Every group was left without a colour, which would turn the whole strip off. Give at least one group a colour.

abort.no_running_effect: No effect is running, so there are no colours to change. Pick an effect on the light card first, or use the light card's colour wheel for a plain colour.
abort.effect_paints_its_own_colours: The running effect paints its own colours, so it takes no palette. Pick a different effect if you want to choose the colours.
abort.effect_stopped: The effect stopped before the colours could be applied. Pick it again on the light card and retry.

pattern.name: Pattern
pattern.description: Per-LED spec, e.g. "20xred 15x0,0,255" or "10xw80". A four-part token such as "5x0,0,0,100" lights the white LED for those LEDs.

enter.name: Enter scribble mode
enter.description: Send the mode-entry command first. Leave on unless the strip is already in scribble mode.

set_segments.name: Set segments
set_segments.description: Apply static colours to the 20 fixed segments.

colors.name: Colours
colors.description: Up to 20 colours. Missing trailing segments are turned off. Give an entry a white level to drive the W channel instead of simulating white from RGB.

set_timer.name: Set timer
set_timer.description: Write one of the six hardware timer slots.

color.name: Colour
color.description: Only used when the action is "Set colour".

sync_clock.name: Sync clock
sync_clock.description: Push Home Assistant's local time to the controller.

apply_preset.name: Apply preset
apply_preset.description: Apply a bundled holiday preset. Target several controllers to keep them in sync — this is the local replacement for the app's cloud grouping.

apply_look.name: Apply per-LED look
apply_look.description: Render one of the built-in per-LED patterns on the whole strip.

palette.name: Palette
palette.description: Optional colours; the rainbow look ignores them. A white level on an entry is accepted and treated as that colour.

scribble_effect.name: Per-LED effect
scribble_effect.description: 0 static, 1 flowing, 2 twinkling, 5 stars wink, 8 accumulate.

save_scene.name: Save scene
save_scene.description: Create or replace a named scene, optionally bound to a season.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Which part of the scene drives the strip.

colors.name: Colours
colors.description: Solid-colour scenes use the first colour; effect scenes cycle through all. A white level on an entry drives the W channel, so (white, no colour) is a real white and not an RGB imitation.

white.name: Warm white level
white.description: 0-255 W-channel level for warm-white scenes. This is the white LED, not simulated RGB white.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: Native effect name, used by effect scenes.

segments.name: Segments
segments.description: Up to 20 colours, used by segment scenes. A white level on an entry drives the W channel for that segment.

start.name: Season start
start.description: First eligible day as MM-DD; windows wrap the year end.

end.name: Season end
end.description: Last eligible day as MM-DD, inclusive.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Comma-separated labels used by the daily service.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Higher wins when several scenes are eligible.

apply_scene.name: Apply scene
apply_scene.description: Apply a stored scene to one or more controllers.

apply_scene_for_date.name: Apply scene for a date
apply_scene_for_date.description: Apply whichever stored scene belongs to a given day, based on seasons and tags.

date.name: Date
date.description: Defaults to today in Home Assistant's time zone.

topic.name: Tag filter
topic.description: Only consider scenes carrying this tag.

randomize.name: Randomize
randomize.description: Pick pseudo-randomly among eligible scenes; the pick is seeded from the date.

import_scenes.name: Import scenes
import_scenes.description: Load several scenes at once from a list of scene definitions.

scenes.name: Scenes
scenes.description: A list of scene definitions, each with at least a name and mode.

replace_all.name: Replace everything
replace_all.description: Delete every existing scene before importing.
